currentParagraphText: “The Forest Fae primarily relies on illusion magic, mysticism, and nature magic. It’s possible she can hide and remain undetected while still staying on the island, but from the sound of mana, she is towards the center of the island... the same place there the Chimera lives,” the Sovereign answered, the rainbow-colored magic still lingering in the air from the ritual he had performed.
